IMPORTANT: Do not submit or upload attachments containing sensitive Personal Identifiable Information (PII) such as your social security number, credit card numbers, passport ID, driver's license number, birthdate, or any personal financial data. If sensitive information is detected, your submission may not be processed.

Documents related to your complaint

Optionally, you can upload copies of the documents related to your complaint. This includes:

  • Your written contact with the airline such as an email to the airline’s customer service department or a copy of your online complaint with the airline or ticket agent
  • The airline's written response (unless they did not respond within 30 days)
  • Booking details (ticket / invoice / itinerary / confirmation)
  • All receipts related to the complaint (hotel, taxi, meals, etc.)

Files must be less than: 5 MB

Allowed File types: .doc, .docx, .eml, .gif, .jpeg, .jpg, .msg, .pdf, .png, .txt, .xls, .xlsx

 

Notes:

  • Documents provided should be in English to the maximum extent possible
  • There is a limit of 5 documents for uploading.
